subject: Commit sweep: lock figures + draft board narrative
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit sweep: lock figures + draft board narrative

Team —

We need a tight commit sweep for Q3 board prep. Please update stage and close probability on any deals you own by EOD Monday so finance can lock ARR and bookings for the snapshot. Primary asks: 

- Update HubSpot deal stage and close date for any movement (even small changes)
- Confirm whether number in the Q3_commit_matrix (attached) is firm or subject to credit/procurement delay
- If you want the deal excluded from the commit for board narrative, reply with the reason and recommended language

I'll be drafting the short board blurb about bookings velocity and any one-off credit items. Tessa — can you take the lead on the bookings waterfall figure once numbers land? Vivek/Laura — call out any deals that are >$250k or have procurement/contracting flags.

Attachment: Q3_commit_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet: deal list, owner, ACV, close_prob, target_close_date)

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit sweep: lock figures + draft board narrative

Thanks Rachel — quick updates from pipeline side: 

- NimbleHealth (Aaron Cole) — moving to Legal (was Contracting). Sales intent >= 80% but procurement signed off is pending. Recommend we leave as 75% for commit until we get signature.
- Acme Analytics — verbal yes, procurement loop started; their procurement rep asked for a 60-day data-retention exception which is non-standard. That could push to end of quarter if they insist. Suggest we mark as 40% for commit unless procurement escalates.
- Two mid-market renewals (smaller) will likely slip to next quarter; I flagged them in HubSpot.

I'll update the spreadsheet by Monday morning. One ask — Rachel, do we have an approved playbook language for excluding deals due to procurement exceptions? If not, I can propose wording.

Looping in the specifics I promised. Updated hubspot + matrix. Key notes: 

- NimbleHealth (Owner: Jonas originally, I picked it up) — Legal has one redline (data residency). Sales reports signature intent high but legal review may add 10–14 days. Recommend we treat as 65% commit.
- Acme Analytics — the 60-day retention ask is a deal-breaker for our standard hosted terms. Sales told them we can escalate but can't promise exception. Recommend exclude from commit; add note that procurement is negotiating.
- BlueHarbor renewal (small) — confirmed will slip to Oct; marked out of Q3.

Attachment: Board_Prep_Snapshot.pdf (snapshot of top 25 deals highlighting >250k)

Laura Bennett
VP Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Aaron — looping you in so you have visibility to how we're preparing the board snapshot. Per sales, NimbleHealth is in legal review and looks positive; we will tentatively include at 65% commit in our internal snapshot. If procurement pushes any new terms that materially change timing/value, please flag ASAP.

Internal — Vivek/Laura: I've baked your probability recommendations into the working snapshot. Tessa, please use the Board_Prep_Snapshot.pdf as the source for the bookings waterfall.

Suggested exclusion language (for board note): 
"Deals are included in the commit snapshot if there is an agreed commercial term signed or sign-off from customer procurement/legal. Deals with outstanding non-standard legal/retention exceptions are excluded until exceptions are resolved. Expected timing and reasons for exclusion are annotated in the snapshot."

Attachment: Board_Prep_Snapshot.pdf

Thanks — numbers look good after your inputs. I completed the bookings waterfall and initial narrative draft; see brief below and I've exported the final snapshot to Drive. If everyone approves, I'll lock the PDF for the board deck.

Draft board blurb (2–3 lines):
"Q3 bookings momentum remained healthy with strong demand in healthcare and fintech verticals. Incremental ARR is expected to close at $3.2M, with $2.7M treated as committed based on signed commercial terms and procurement sign-off. Two larger opportunities (NimbleHealth and Acme Analytics) are tracked as conditional: NimbleHealth is in legal review and included at 65% probability; Acme Analytics remains excluded pending negotiation of a non-standard retention term. No material credit issues were identified that would change the present quarter’s visibility."

I uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/board/Q3-snapshot (Board_Prep_Snapshot.pdf) and Q3_commit_matrix.xlsx is updated in the same folder.

Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 18:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final lock + next steps for board package

All — thank you for the fast turnaround. We will treat the snapshot below as final for board materials unless you raise a material change before 9am PT Monday.

Summary (final internal commit snapshot):
- Total incremental ARR targeted for Q3: $3,200,000
- Committed ARR (per board language): $2,700,000
- Key conditional/out: NimbleHealth (included at 65%); Acme Analytics (excluded pending retention term)

Action items: 
- Vivek: confirm any final HubSpot adjustments by Mon 9am PT
- Laura: confirm there are no outstanding credit/legal flags beyond the two noted deals
- Tessa: export final waterfall slide and add to the board deck (Drive link above)
- Rachel: finalize board blurb and share with execs for sign-off Monday morning

Attachments: Q3_commit_matrix.xlsx (final), Board_Prep_Snapshot.pdf (final)

Rachel Kim
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
